# Forbidden-path tripwire: agent-machinery paths that must never reappear.
#
# Two groups, matched against every tracked path (git ls-files). A match fails
# the build even if the file is empty, because the PATH is the regression, not
# its content. Each line is an extended regex.
#
# [exact]    matched CASE-SENSITIVELY. Each has one real name; a case variant is
#            not a plausible accident, and case-insensitivity here would
#            false-positive on legitimate content such as src/content/skills.md
#            or a docs/agent.md.
# [workflow] matched CASE-INSENSITIVELY, over the whole basename. A human
#            copy-pasting or a tool regenerating a workflow can produce
#            Reviewer.yml or SCOUT.yaml, so every capitalization and both the
#            .yml and .yaml spellings must fail.

[exact]
^agent/
^functions/
(^|/)scout-prompt\.md$
(^|/)reviewer-prompt\.md$
(^|/)SKILLS\.md$
(^|/)projects-context\.md$
(^|/)sources\.yaml$
(^|/)agent-ci-settings\.json$
(^|/)AGENT\.md$

[workflow]
(^|/)scout\.ya?ml$
(^|/)reviewer\.ya?ml$
